heat.description: u_t=u_xx on (0,1), t in [0,0.1], zero Dirichlet boundaries, u(x,0)=sin(pi*x); all variables dimensionless
heat.joint_time_rule: M=3*N*N/5, dt=h*h/6, both explicit and implicit Euler

adaptive_time.criterion: eta <= rate*dt; eta is the max difference of one backward Euler step and two half steps; adopt two half steps

adaptive_space.description: -u''=-12*x*x on (0,1), u(0)=0, u(1)=1, u=x^4; linear finite elements with exact polynomial loads
adaptive_space.indicator: eta_K=(b-a)^2*max_K(abs(u''))/8=1.5*(b-a)^2*b^2; source-derived curvature bound for interpolation, not a general residual estimator
